Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 618 PM EST Fri Nov 6 2026

- Decreasing coverage of isolated showers into tonight with mostly 
  dry and cooler conditions tomorrow. 

- Dry with temperatures a few degrees above normal by Sunday into 
  early next week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Compact mesoscale low pressure system is currently digging southward 
over the relatively warm waters of the southern Lake Huron basin. 
Good wraparound deformation forcing exists across some portions of 
the area with light rain activity currently relegated to the Thumb. 
Strong northerly winds have remained confined to the open waters. 
The center of the low will remain vertically stacked as parent 
vorticity maximum wobbles and digs southward to the eastern Lake 
Erie basin by 12z Saturday. Loss of daytime heating and vertical 
mixing this evening will result in lowering ceilings. An axis of 
better low level moisture is expected to advect across the area 
during the late evening and bring a chance for light showers or 
drizzle. Dry air advection and return of daytime mixing will result 
in VFR sky conditions Saturday.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for ceiling 5000 ft or less through Saturday morning.
